description: Accept or reject individual photos in a photo-capture submission. Reviewing is only possible while the submission is pending_review. Provide at least one photo ID in accept or reject; IDs not in this submission are ignored. Accepted photos are what get_accepted_photos_archive downloads. Photo review does not pay the worker: approve the overall submission with review_submission, then pay with release_payment. Owner only.
